notes: One defective Synthetic portrait withdrawn, and the machinery so that withdrawing one stops leaving a hole. DROID5 IS GONE. Fifth face in the Synthetic group. The file is deleted and the id is out of the manifest, so the picker is 257 across seven groups and Synthetic is 99. THAT ALONE WOULD HAVE BEEN THE WORSE HALF OF A FIX. The allowlist is a directory read at boot, so deleting the file stops anyone SELECTING it and does nothing about anyone already wearing it. The header badge is a background image, which means a missing file there is not a broken image icon, it is an empty square with the add-a-portrait control suppressed: no face, and no way to see that anything is wrong or go get another one, because the picker no longer offers what you are wearing. So the server now clears withdrawn ids at boot and the wearer falls back to the picker. THE CHAMBER NEEDED THE SAME PASS, and not as a courtesy: council posts fall back to the portrait frozen at post time only when the speaker has none live, so clearing the live one is exactly what hands the render back to the dead id. Both sweeps run together or the first creates work for the second. THE SWEEP REFUSES TO RUN if the directory read failed or came back implausibly small. Missing a dead id costs one blank avatar until the next restart. Running against an empty set would clear the portrait off every account on the station with no undo. Those are not the same size of mistake and are not treated as one. It logs every id it clears and says so when it clears nothing. SERVER RESTART REQUIRED. Hard refresh.
